CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSIsDate

Returns True if the string can be converted to a date/time value using the date conventions of the current locale.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSIsDate(string)

Parameters

string
The string to test.

Returns

True (YES) or False (NO). Plain numbers are not considered dates.

Usage

Check user input with LSIsDate before passing it to LSParseDateTime. In KoldFusion, which formats and parses in English (US) only (see SetLocale), LSIsDate works exactly like IsDate: "12/31/1999" and "Dec 31, 1999" are dates, but the European "31.12.1999" is not.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = "12/31/1999|Dec 31, 1999|December 31, 1999 11:59 PM|31.12.1999|2/30/2000|1999|soon">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>LSIsDate</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="S" LIST="#Tests#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#S#</TD><TD>#LSIsDate(S)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
